temporary_bound_rule.basis: Keep the existing three-raw/two-compressed bound with15 percent growth on both measured raw and compressed bytes, plus2 GiB on the physical volume for temporary bookkeeping and one serial analysis operation. No parallel simulation/export/build work is allowed. The original guard still reserves at least8 GiB and checks actual capacity before every formal slot.

offline_replay20.basis: Reserve8 GiB for20 formal velocity recordings' arrays, online/native/truth sidecars, four estimator outputs and audit tables; roughly409.6 MiB per source. Original bags are already in per-slot persistent storage. Serial decompression uses the separate temporary reserve. This does not assert any export or replay has run.

videos12.basis: Reserve2 GiB for12 selected seed1000 browser video copies and indexes, roughly170.7 MiB per clip. Immutable onboard originals are already in measured trial bytes. Preserve the complete recorded duration and failures; no shorter successful-only clip is assumed.

detection_audit.basis: Reserve4 GiB for both original single-target detection subsets plus all12 prospective full-task supplementary sources: original sampled RGB, prediction-free all-actor overlays, independent review, schema2 caches, evaluation and timing/lineage attachments. Sampling remains FOLLOW+1s then every2s to final recorded Clock with no image cap; approximately40 opportunities per75s source is only a planning scale, not a fixed count or license to truncate tails.

figures_documents.basis: Reserve2 GiB for statistics, figures, unified HTML, Word/PDF, per-page rendering images and the small shareable delivery package. Document rendering and visual review remain required.

runtime_logs.basis: Reserve2 GiB for remaining external owner/monitor/registration and document-tool logs beyond per-trial measured logs. Raw experiment failures remain preserved. No deletion or NTFS savings are assumed.

assumptions_values.basis: 2026-11-03 prospective planning allowance, chosen before full28 measurement and before all formal STARTs. Applies only if the actual storage-probe confirms results and the UAVHumble22 VHD are both on the single drive_D physical volume. These are explicit engineering allowances, not observed future sizes or a capacity approval. Recompute the real budget from all28 completed 75s development cells; retain an insufficient-space result rather than decreasing margins to fit.
